dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: Ahem... "Melodious night breeze, be my words, express the daylight delights"...

dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: "Here I stand in the wind, just to hear your gentle sing-along."

dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: What do you think of that?

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: What do I think of what?

dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: The lovely poem I just composed. How does it make you feel?

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: Is this... for your literature class?

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I don't quite get it...
